headline: IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high‑fliers and modest profit pressure.
summary: Coforge posted the strongest top‑line growth at 53.6% YoY, while most peers stayed in the low‑teens. Profit margins improved at HCLTech and Mphasis, but Wipro and Persistent saw profit declines. AI revenue contributions are becoming material, especially at Infosys, HCLTech and TCS. Guidance remains cautious, with Infosys trimming its FY27 outlook.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI‑related wins, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s advanced AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins slipped for Wipro and OFSS, while only a few companies raised margin guidance.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Profit jumped 21% YoY, driven by strong AI revenue and solid top‑line growth.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
Profit fell 25% YoY despite 30% revenue growth, indicating earnings weakness.
